qs.s: What is the more comprehensive definition of Prophetic Medicine among Muslim modern societies?

qs.s: What is the impact of healing shrines on the healthcare system in Morocco?

qs.s: What is the mutual impact of the traditional health system and clinical system on the overall healing system in Morocco?
o: The traditional health system and clinical system in Morocco operate independently, with minimal interaction and impact on each other.
The traditional health system and clinical system in Morocco are in direct competition, leading to a fragmented healing system.

The traditional health system and clinical system in Morocco complement each other for some and collide against each other for some other people. Practitioners from both systems reject each other which makes of the holistic healthcare system in Morocco, complex and more ambiguous.
The traditional health system in Morocco has completely replaced the clinical system, rendering it obsolete.
The clinical system in Morocco dominates the healing system, significantly marginalizing the traditional health system.
